steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Exusiai, any word from Croissant?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah, she says yes.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She said we could store things here for a while if we run out of room at the office, but it's best to ask first.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The shopping festival sale completely stuffed the company warehouses. There's hardly any room to even step inside.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah, we haven't been so busy in ages.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Never imagined there was so much storage space under Croissant's room.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She told me she rented two floors, one for living and one for storage.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She's organized all the stuff into categories. Makes you feel better just looking at it.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Fruit cans... let's see... crafts, toiletries, clothing, food. Here, I think.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What are these boxes over here?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Magnificent Machine Oil?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Exusiai! Came as soon as I heard. Didja find a place fer yer stuff?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yes, but... I saw a bunch of machine oil over there. How did you get the goods so quickly?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You still had money left? Didn't you just borrow some from me last month to buy a bunch of cloth?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That's the old kind I had in stock. I was thinkin' about sellin' it to raise the capital to buy the new stuff.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Will people really buy obsolete ones like these?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It's from early this year, but it's still good to use. And cheaper'n the new kind. I'm sure I'll have takers.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Just from early this year? Wow, they sure release updates fast.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Two new versions in a year. Yep, they must put some juice into R&D.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Croissant...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What's on yer mind, Sora?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It'd be hard for me to guarantee quality if a record company wanted me to release two albums in a year, but I don't know the situation here...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: S'fine, I've used this machine oil fer ages. The quality's good.

steps.name: Car Radio
steps.text: Rusty machines? Wear and tear? Joints getting stuck?

steps.name: Car Radio
steps.text: Get the latest Magnificent Machine Oil now! Temperature and oxidation-resistant, high viscosity and high purity. It's the best option!

steps.name: Car Radio
steps.text: A new secret ingredient keeps your machinery running good-as-new. Discover brand-new experiences with five different effects.

steps.name: Car Radio
steps.text: Buy a whole set and enjoy a secret bonus. Live life to the fullest. Choose Magnificent.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Can we turn the radio off?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Magnificent don't spare any expense on advertising, do they?

steps.name: Car Radio
steps.text: New limited-edition machine oil in collaboration with famous Lungmen craftsman Tsui-Tsui! Get it online or in stores now.

steps.name: Car Radio
steps.text: The first hundred orders will also get a free set of maintenance tools, autographed by Tsui-Tsui. Call our hotline now!

steps.name: Low Male Voice
steps.text: Magnificent, the choice of a master. I am Tsui-Tsui, and I endorse this message.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hey, ain't that the engineer who's all the rage on the video websites right now? Didn't think he'd do a collab with Magnificent. Guess he really likes the new product.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Word of mouth is the important thing. The opinion of one master doesn't mean much.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: People're linin' up to buy it. More popular'n I ever thought it could be.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gotta stock up on a sure-seller like that!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's a sure-seller, sure. What about your stock, though?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sigh... all the vendors what came to me were offerin' cents on the dollar, like they were colludin' or somethin'. Musta found out I need cash on short notice.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So what are you thinking? Are you selling?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'll hafta, if'n I don't get any news within the week.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's what it is. You win some, and you lose some.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, bless your heart. Makin' me feel better, Exusiai?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ahem. Watch the road, not me.

steps.name: Car Radio
steps.text: Fragrances on sale now! Great deals on everything! All the fragrance you could want at shocking discounts! Call Dainty Fragrances at xxxxxxxx if interested.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hah, looks like I ain't the only one tryin' to clear out stock.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's a pretty stiff laugh, Croissant.

steps.name: Car Radio
steps.text: Live a healthier life with oat milk and coffee. One plus one can equal more than two.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Man, ads these days are just getting worse and worse.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What'cha mean? I thought it made a lot of sense.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Living a better life with oat milk and coffee?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Naw, the second bit.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: One plus one can equal more than two?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That's the one.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: One moment, miss. The representative of Dainty Fragrances is just inside.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Mr. Chang, there's a young woman with an appointment here. Are you free right now?

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Show her in.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Come on in, Miss.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Mornin', Mr. Chang. Sorry to show up all unannounced-like.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Not a problem, Miss. How should I call you?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Croissant's the name.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Very good, Croissant. May I ask why you're here?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well, I happen to have some stock of Magnificent Machine Oil that I'm tryin' to get off my hands, but it's been mighty tough findin' a buyer.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: I'm afraid we don't need any machine oil. We're having headaches trying to sell our own stock as it is.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Wags a finger)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I ain't tryin' to sell ya my goods.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Then why are you here?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'm after a little cooperation.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Forgive me for being blunt, but it doesn't look like you have such great marketing channels yourself.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And I ain't offerin' a channel, neither. I'm proposin' a strategy.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: A strategy?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Darn tootin'. A win-win strategy.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: And what might that be?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We sell our stock in a package deal.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Outdated machine oil and out-of-fashion fragrance. Seems like a combination doomed to fail.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: My machine oil comes with a mighty strong smell. Tackin' on a fragrance helps clear that right up.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: The real kicker's gonna be the variety of fragrances your company offers.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oil plus perfume ain't nothin' special, but the variety you got makes it interesting.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We could even do up a 'random fragrance' package to add to the fun.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: (Nods approvingly)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Now, why don'tcha tell me what yer best-sellin' smell is?

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Rose.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Let's toss that one out as a free gift.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Why would we give away the one that sells the best?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We ain't just givin' it out. You gotta collect a couple other fragrance sets to get the free gift.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: I see. What if we run out, though? We don't have a lot of rose fragrance in stock.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: In that case, we do a lucky draw.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya get one chance at the draw for every full set of fragrance you collect.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: I see. I can come up with something as a consolation prize, and we give out the machine oil and fragrances as the second and third prizes.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: But I'll need to think about the grand prize...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'm thinkin' I'n offer the grand prize. It pains my heart, but it's all in the name of business.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: A poster autographed by Emperor himself.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Are you serious?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sure am... I've this feller fer a mighty long time.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Oh yeah, I get to put my Employee of the Year Award to good use. It's just takin' up space.)

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: This discussion has been most illuminating, Croissant. Now, about the revenue share...

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: I believe it's only fair that my company gets a bigger cut, considering the major role that our fragrance plays.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'd say it's too early to talk about that. Let's put our heads together on a detailed sales strategy first.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Very well. Here's my card. Feel free to contact us at any time.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That'd be lovely, Mr. Chang. Here's mine.

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Oh—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Chang
steps.text: Oh, nothing. I've just never seen a business card so... cute.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Leaves an impression, don't it?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You're back. How did it go?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Mighty fine. We didn't settle on the revenue split though.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What's your plan?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Maybe I'll call him up now.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gotta find his number. Flip through my rolodex here... boutique, appliances store, farm equipment, barber... here ya are, Dainty Fragrances.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Man, you have so many cards it's dragging on the ground. Do you have a detailed plan, though?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Detailed plan? Too early fer that.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Howdy, Mr. Chang? I dropped by earlier today.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yep, it's me, Croissant.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I just finished tallyin' up the goods and I'm ready to package 'em. There's just one thing...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: A workshop of sorts called me up. They're mighty interested in the oil...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And, er... well, the lady offered an awful temptin' price.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: No, I ain't given 'em an answer yet. I'd love to work with a big company like yours, but...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sure, I understand, but business is business.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh no, she's comin'. Gimme a sec.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (She's one heck of an actress...)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Covers the receiver lightly)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What?! You really want my entire stock?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I-I couldn't do that. I promised to sell it as a bundle with a real nice pardner. I-It ain't about the money.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yer desperate? But... I just ain't sure... alright, I'll think about it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Releases the receiver)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waitin', Mr. Chang. They're awful persistent... they said they just got a big project and need a whole heap of machine oil.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You'll increase my share? A-Are ya sure?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Aw, I do appreciate that so very much. Thank you kindly! Would you have time tomorrow mornin' to pick up our chat? That'd be lovely. See ya tomorrow, Mr. Chang.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You have a deal?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sure do.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Now I got the capital for new goods, and I'll also get to pay back my debt. That's some mighty fine luck.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Have you ever thought about a career in acting, Croissant?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Nah, ain't worth it... hey, you aren't serious, are you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Shrugs)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well... that went awful good.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Looks at her own reflection in the mirror)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Go make that money, Croissant. If you don't, somebody else will.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That's the last box! Let's see... two left. Not bad! Made my money back even before I sold out.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I didn't understand why you would stock up like that, but now I guess it makes sense.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Mom n' Dad trained my instincts up like this. They're mighty precise.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Family of businessmen?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Guess so. I grew up helpin' out around their little shop. So their thinkin' and habits've rubbed off on me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Have you found someone for the remaining machine oil?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Customer feedback was good, so I'm plannin' on keepin' it for myself.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Can I have a bottle?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You can have a whole box, if you want.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Checks the labels)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What'cha you lookin' for?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The ingredients. I need to know if it can be used on firearms.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh yeah, I was so busy procurin', I never had a chance to look at what they added to the new version.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I still got the old bottles. We could compare 'em.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Here we go! Let's see... what did they add?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: 75% mineral oil.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Same. Additives?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Viscosity improver, antioxidant, anti-corrosive...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Don't see anythin' different. What was the secret ingredient they were talkin' up in the ad?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wait, there's something at the end... rose oxide?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Whassat? Lemme look it up... rose oxide is a fragrance chemical found in roses and rose oil.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So all the new version added was a fragrance?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I feel... like I got played.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, you know what they say. Great minds think alike.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Pats Croissant on the shoulder)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Let's go. We have orders to deliver tonight.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Aren't you going, Croissant?
One month later...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why is there always a line here? It wraps all the way around the corner.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Must be some new product launch.

steps.name: Screen Ad
steps.text: Brand-new Magnificent Machine Oil, now in stores! Elevate your experience and personalize your very own fragrance from one of a dozen options!

steps.name: Screen Ad
steps.text: Order now and get a mystery gift in partnership with Dainty Fragrances!

steps.name: Screen Ad
steps.text: Live life to the fullest. Choose Magnificent.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Another new version? Didn't they just release one last month?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You think Croissant is in line?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You would think so, but...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm gonna guess she's not.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She's been pretty depressed lately. She turned down all my invitations to go shopping or eat together, and she's not even taking care of her business.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Did you know that the little warehouse she has is completely empty?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Looks like she got a big shock. All that effort to learn you've been played by the manufacturer...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: She's not gonna just give up, is she? I haven't seen her for days.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No idea, but I'm beginning to miss her bounciness, whether she made or lost money the day before.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Me too. But the name Dainty Fragrances does sound familiar.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: See, I was right. No Croissant.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Evenin', folks. Might I interest you in a new flavor of crispy meatballs after a hard day of work?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Are you guys going back? I'll give ya a ride.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Turns sideways)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ahem. Notice anything new?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Er... a new hairstyle?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Not me. The display window behind me.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, that. Yeah, I knew about it a week ago.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wasn't this a new product released today?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Heard it from Magnificent myself. I introduced 'em to Chang, and they gave me a chance to buy their new product ahead of time, at a discount.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: No wonder it sounded familiar... you've stocked up on the new goods, then?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: No, I turned 'em down.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why? Isn't that a chance to make a bunch of money?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Nah, I decided not to get mixed up. I already got me a new sales plan.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What are you planning to sell?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wow, these crispy meatballs are great!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hehe.
